newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-FIORENTINA FANS WARNED FOR COIN THROWING.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-FIORENTINA FANS WARNED FOR COIN THROWING.

text.p: Fiorentina fans were issued with a warning on Thursday after Barcelona defender Sergi Barjuan appeared to be hit by a coin thrown from the crowd during a European Cup Winners' Cup semifinal second leg.
Sergi collapsed to the ground and received treatment immediately after midfielder Josep Guardiola had put the visiting Spanish team 2-0 up, 3-1 ahead on aggregate.
Shortly afterwards, the fans were warned by public announcement that "if any more objects are thrown from the stands, the referee will suspend the match."
